problem.text: Sam drove $96$ miles in $90$ minutes. His average speed during the first $30$ minutes was $60$ mph (miles per hour), and his average speed during the second $30$ minutes was $65$ mph. What was his average speed, in mph, during the last $30$ minutes?

steps.title: Where to start: turn speeds into distances
steps.body: The speeds are in miles per hour, but the times are in minutes. Each $30$ minutes is half an hour, so the distance in each piece of the trip is the speed times $\frac{1}{2}$. Once you know the first two distances, the rest of the $96$ miles belongs to the last half hour.

your_turn.prompt: How many miles did Sam drive in the first $30$ minutes?

steps.title: The second half hour
steps.body: Do the same for the second half hour at $65$ mph. Add it to the first distance to see how far Sam had gone after one hour.

your_turn.prompt: How far did Sam drive in the second $30$ minutes, and how far had he gone after one hour?
your_turn.answer: $32.5$ miles, since $65 \times \frac{1}{2} = 32.5$. After one hour he had gone $30 + 32.5 = 62.5$ miles.

steps.title: Do not stop at the overall average
steps.body: Careful: $96$ miles in $1.5$ hours is an average of $96 \div 1.5 = 64$ mph for the whole trip. That is not the question. The question asks only about the last $30$ minutes.

your_turn.prompt: The first two speeds were $60$ and $65$. Should the last speed be above or below $64$? Why?
your_turn.answer: Above. The first two speeds average only $62.5$, so the last half hour must be faster to pull the overall average up to $64$.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body: The last half hour covered $96 - 62.5 = 33.5$ miles. Going $33.5$ miles in half an hour means $33.5 \times 2 = 67$ miles in a full hour. Check: the three time pieces are equal, so the overall average is the mean of the three speeds, and $(60 + 65 + 67) \div 3 = 64$. The answer is **(D)** $67$.

wrong_choices.A: $64$ is Sam's average speed for the whole $90$ minutes, $96 \div 1.5$. The question asks for his speed in the last $30$ minutes only.

verification.verifier_notes: Passed adversarial verifier on first review.
